row.selection_reason_zh: 区分产物重建与任务可用性，保留为交付正确性的反例；不把单一产物审计当作本月量化主线。
row.selection_reason_en: Separates artifact reproducibility from task functionality. Retained as a delivery-correctness boundary, not as the principal quantization advance.
row.title_zh: 量化产物可重建，仍可能无法完成功能
row.question_zh: 量化产物可以按配方精确重建，却仍可能失去任务功能；文件校验和功能验收需要分别进行。
row.context_zh: 量化产物可以按配方精确重建，却仍可能失去任务功能；文件校验和功能验收需要分别进行。
row.synthesis_zh: 先用15个代码任务筛查可疑GGUF标签，再用164个HumanEval+任务复测；固定权重、工具链和张量组合，比较是否使用重要性矩阵校准。
row.viewpoint_zh: 量化交付同时检查文件与功能。版本变化时比较技术结论是否改变，不能只核对文件哈希或沿用旧版本的缺陷归因。
row.implication_zh: 量化交付同时检查文件与功能。版本变化时比较技术结论是否改变，不能只核对文件哈希或沿用旧版本的缺陷归因。
row.boundary_zh: 已核对v2研究设计和有效性威胁章节。结果限于所测代码模型和产物；未提供昇腾复现，不把15题筛查阈值直接用于翻译或降噪业务。
row.title_en: A reproducible quantized artifact can still be non-functional
row.question_en: A quantized artifact may be exactly reproducible yet fail its tasks; file validation and functionality testing are separate requirements.
row.context_en: A quantized artifact may be exactly reproducible yet fail its tasks; file validation and functionality testing are separate requirements.
row.synthesis_en: Screen GGUF tags with 15 coding tasks, retest suspects on 164 HumanEval+ tasks, and compare importance-matrix calibration while holding weights, toolchain and tensor mix fixed.
row.viewpoint_en: Validate files and functions separately, and recheck technical conclusions when the paper version changes.
row.implication_en: Validate files and functions separately, and recheck technical conclusions when the paper version changes.
row.boundary_en: Selected design and validity sections of v2 were checked. Evidence concerns the evaluated coding models and artifacts, with no local Ascend reproduction; the screening threshold is not a universal business acceptance criterion.

row.selection_reason_zh: 尝试用压缩缩放关系减少配置搜索，连接多种压缩机制；模型拟合和外推适用范围仍需逐设置判断。
row.selection_reason_en: Studies compression scaling to reduce configuration search across mechanisms; fitting and extrapolation still require configuration-specific assessment.
row.title_zh: 压缩缩放关系：减少配置测量，但不能替代业务质量验证
row.question_zh: 相同的资源缩减可能造成不同能力损失，逐配置试验昂贵，但预测器本身也有测量和重新拟合成本。
row.context_zh: 相同的资源缩减可能造成不同能力损失，逐配置试验昂贵，但预测器本身也有测量和重新拟合成本。
row.synthesis_zh: 将不同剪枝密度的响应形状共享，用较少配置测量拟合能力损失；再检验预测选型是否优于配置中位数或固定方法优先级。
row.viewpoint_zh: 将它作为缩小配置空间的候选方法，计入重新拟合与测量成本，并保留简单固定优先级对照，不直接输出新模型的最优部署配置。
row.implication_zh: 将它作为缩小配置空间的候选方法，计入重新拟合与测量成本，并保留简单固定优先级对照，不直接输出新模型的最优部署配置。
row.boundary_zh: 已核对§2.2、§5.1–5.2、§6。nats/token不是任务准确率百分点，矩阵参数载荷不是峰值显存；交叉熵选型也不保证生成任务exact-match最优。
row.title_en: Compression scaling-down laws can reduce measurements without replacing task validation
row.question_en: Equal resource reductions can cause different capability losses; exhaustive testing is expensive, but predictors also require measurements and refitting.
row.context_en: Equal resource reductions can cause different capability losses; exhaustive testing is expensive, but predictors also require measurements and refitting.
row.synthesis_en: Share a response shape across pruning densities to fit capability-loss predictors from fewer configuration measurements, then compare selection against configuration medians and fixed method priorities.
row.viewpoint_en: Include predictor refitting and measurement costs, keep a fixed-priority baseline, and validate generated-task quality before treating a configuration as optimal.
row.implication_en: Include predictor refitting and measurement costs, keep a fixed-priority baseline, and validate generated-task quality before treating a configuration as optimal.
row.boundary_en: Sections 2.2, 5.1–5.2 and 6 were checked. Nats/token is not task-accuracy points, parameter storage is not peak memory, and cross-entropy selection need not maximize generation exact match.

row.selection_reason_zh: 补充码本利用率这一不同于旋转的误差控制机制；因为具体实验条件未展开，暂不作为已验证领先方案。
row.selection_reason_en: Adds codebook utilization as an error-control mechanism distinct from rotation; missing experimental detail prevents treating it as a verified leading method.
row.title_zh: BARQ：在离线拟合中均衡码字利用率
row.question_zh: 最近码字分配可能使部分码字长期得不到充分更新，降低低比特码本的利用率。
row.context_zh: 最近码字分配可能使部分码字长期得不到充分更新，降低低比特码本的利用率。
row.synthesis_zh: 以曲率加权重建代价和均匀边际进行熵正则最优输运分配，再按分配权重更新码字；部署前丢弃软分配，恢复硬最近码字编码。
row.viewpoint_zh: 优先验证是否能以离线拟合成本换取固定部署格式的质量提升；在具体位宽和代码核对前保留为观察。
row.implication_zh: 优先验证是否能以离线拟合成本换取固定部署格式的质量提升；在具体位宽和代码核对前保留为观察。
row.boundary_zh: 仅摘要证据。有限 Sinkhorn 迭代的更新最优性还要求各码字质量超过分母下限；不能据此保证所有硬量化设置都提升。
row.title_en: BARQ: balancing codeword use during offline fitting
row.question_en: Nearest-codeword fitting can leave some codewords under-updated, reducing codebook utilization.
row.context_en: Nearest-codeword fitting can leave some codewords under-updated, reducing codebook utilization.
row.synthesis_en: Uses entropic optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted costs, followed by assignment-weighted codeword updates. Soft assignments are discarded for hard nearest-codeword deployment.
row.viewpoint_en: Check whether offline fitting cost improves quality without changing the deployed format; retain as an observation until bit-width and implementation comparisons are checked.
row.implication_en: Check whether offline fitting cost improves quality without changing the deployed format; retain as an observation until bit-width and implementation comparisons are checked.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only. Optimality for finite Sinkhorn iterations requires codeword masses above the denominator floor; it does not guarantee improvement for every hard-quantization setting.

row.selection_reason_zh: 同时改变搜索目标与解码路径，并明确比较 QTIP/Proteus，能支撑对两比特量化路线的技术取舍。
row.selection_reason_en: Changes both the search objective and decoder path, with explicit QTIP/Proteus comparisons that inform two-bit design tradeoffs.
row.title_zh: CurveTQ：把曲率放进编码搜索，重新比较旋转的必要性
row.question_zh: Trellis/格点量化常在编码前旋转权重，但旋转增加执行路径；已有误差反馈未完全利用编码块内的曲率。
row.context_zh: Trellis/格点量化常在编码前旋转权重，但旋转增加执行路径；已有误差反馈未完全利用编码块内的曲率。
row.synthesis_zh: 把 Hessian LDL 分解的对角权重加入 Viterbi 分支度量，在原始坐标搜索；以因子尺度、分位数表和每块起始状态处理幅度、分布与残差。
row.viewpoint_zh: 这是对“低比特必须依赖旋转”的可检验替代路线。比较时应同时给基线相同起始状态，并把存储元数据计入位预算。
row.implication_zh: 这是对“低比特必须依赖旋转”的可检验替代路线。比较时应同时给基线相同起始状态，并把存储元数据计入位预算。
row.boundary_zh: 仅摘要核对。精确模型名、任务集合、有效位宽中的尺度/状态开销和绝对解码速度仍待实验表核验；不能把解码核排序写成服务 TTFT 或 TPOT 提升。
row.title_en: CurveTQ: curvature-aware coding tests whether rotation is necessary
row.question_en: Trellis/lattice quantization commonly rotates weights, adding execution work, while block error feedback can leave within-block curvature unused.
row.context_en: Trellis/lattice quantization commonly rotates weights, adding execution work, while block error feedback can leave within-block curvature unused.
row.synthesis_en: Places diagonal weights from the Hessian LDL factorization into Viterbi branch metrics in the native basis, using factored scales, quantile tables and per-block start states for amplitude, shape and residual adaptation.
row.viewpoint_en: A testable alternative to assuming low-bit coding requires rotation. Compare baselines with the same start-state enhancement and include metadata in the bit budget.
row.implication_en: A testable alternative to assuming low-bit coding requires rotation. Compare baselines with the same start-state enhancement and include metadata in the bit budget.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only. Exact models, tasks, effective-bit overhead from scales/states and absolute decoder speed need experimental-table checks; decoder ranking is not a serving TTFT/TPOT result.

row.selection_reason_zh: 关注剪枝破坏预测轨迹后如何恢复，作为稀疏与蒸馏的交叉路线；不能代表独立蒸馏全貌，当前仅核对摘要。
row.selection_reason_en: Studies recovery after pruning damages prediction trajectories. A pruning-distillation interaction, not a complete view of standalone distillation; currently abstract checked.
row.title_zh: ReCal：在剪枝前保护蒸馏恢复所依赖的预测
row.question_zh: 剪枝改变学生生成轨迹，离线蒸馏后残留的预测损伤还会限制后续在线蒸馏恢复。
row.context_zh: 剪枝改变学生生成轨迹，离线蒸馏后残留的预测损伤还会限制后续在线蒸馏恢复。
row.synthesis_zh: 用未剪枝教师与剪枝探针的前向KL识别受损的教师支持预测，重加权校准统计，再交给既有剪枝准则，改善后续on-policy蒸馏恢复。
row.viewpoint_zh: 进一步核对相同学生、恢复预算和校准成本下，ReCal相对原剪枝＋OPD的独立增益，以及质量改善是否保留实际结构和速度收益。
row.implication_zh: 进一步核对相同学生、恢复预算和校准成本下，ReCal相对原剪枝＋OPD的独立增益，以及质量改善是否保留实际结构和速度收益。
row.boundary_zh: 目前仅摘要已读，作为待深入核验的新机制候选；最高值不能写成普遍恢复比例，也不能推断业务精度损失或推理加速。
row.title_en: ReCal protects predictions needed for on-policy recovery before pruning
row.question_en: Pruning changes student-generated trajectories, and residual prediction damage after offline distillation can limit subsequent on-policy recovery.
row.context_en: Pruning changes student-generated trajectories, and residual prediction damage after offline distillation can limit subsequent on-policy recovery.
row.synthesis_en: Forward KL between an unpruned teacher and a pruned probe identifies damaged teacher-supported predictions. Reweighted calibration statistics guide existing pruning criteria before on-policy distillation recovery.
row.viewpoint_en: Check independent recovery gains at matched student, calibration and OPD budgets, and verify that recovered quality retains structural deployment benefits.
row.implication_en: Check independent recovery gains at matched student, calibration and OPD budgets, and verify that recovered quality retains structural deployment benefits.
row.boundary_en: Abstract reviewed only: a mechanism candidate for deeper checking. The maximum is not a universal recovery rate and establishes neither business-quality loss nor inference speedup.

row.selection_reason_zh: 补上激活量化与真实执行这一缺口；入选依据是 W/A 耦合机制和打包实现，而不是只看最高加速倍数。
row.selection_reason_en: Fills the activation/execution gap through its coupled W/A mechanism and packed implementation, not merely its maximum speedup.
row.title_zh: DualQuant：从权重重建得到激活缩放，连接算法与真实 W4A4 执行
row.question_zh: 权重压到四比特并不能自动实现低比特计算收益；激活量化通常还需要校准数据。
row.context_zh: 权重压到四比特并不能自动实现低比特计算收益；激活量化通常还需要校准数据。
row.synthesis_zh: 以双尺度最小化权重重建误差，通过变量分裂和块坐标下降求解；同一缩放同时用于激活通道重缩放。算法声明支持 MX 家族及 NVFP4。
row.viewpoint_zh: 值得与权重单独量化并列研究：它直接处理 W/A 耦合并给出真实打包路径。下一步优先核对具体格式、激活动态量化开销和端到端测试条件。
row.implication_zh: 值得与权重单独量化并列研究：它直接处理 W/A 耦合并给出真实打包路径。下一步优先核对具体格式、激活动态量化开销和端到端测试条件。
row.boundary_zh: 当前核对原始摘要。MX/NVFP4 是算法格式覆盖，不能据此认定 RTX 4090 原生支持 NVFP4；摘要未充分交代两项最大收益的配置、内存分母、batch 与执行格式，不合并为同一测试点，也不换算为 TTFT/TPOT。
row.title_en: DualQuant: deriving activation scales from weight reconstruction, with packed W4A4 execution
row.question_en: Four-bit weights alone do not realize the full benefit of low-bit arithmetic; activation quantization commonly requires calibration data.
row.context_en: Four-bit weights alone do not realize the full benefit of low-bit arithmetic; activation quantization commonly requires calibration data.
row.synthesis_en: Minimizes weight-reconstruction error with dual scales, using variable splitting and block coordinate descent. The resulting scales also rescale activation channels. The algorithm covers MX and NVFP4 formats.
row.viewpoint_en: Study alongside weight-only quantization: it addresses W/A coupling and reports a real packed path. Check exact formats, dynamic-activation overhead and end-to-end conditions next.
row.implication_en: Study alongside weight-only quantization: it addresses W/A coupling and reports a real packed path. Check exact formats, dynamic-activation overhead and end-to-end conditions next.
row.boundary_en: Primary abstract checked. Algorithmic MX/NVFP4 coverage does not establish native NVFP4 support on RTX 4090. The abstract does not fully specify configurations, memory denominators, batch sizes or execution formats for both maxima; they are not combined into one test point or relabeled as TTFT/TPOT.

row.selection_reason_zh: 用生成行为改进低秩白化和秩分配，补充重建误差之外的优化目标；实验条件尚需进一步核对。
row.selection_reason_en: Uses generative behavior to guide whitening and rank allocation beyond reconstruction error; experimental conditions need further checking.
row.title_zh: GA-SVD：用生成行为指导白化与全局秩分配
row.question_zh: 面向重建误差或选择题优化的SVD，不一定保住自由生成能力；逐层秩的经验分配也可能错配全局预算。
row.context_zh: 面向重建误差或选择题优化的SVD，不一定保住自由生成能力；逐层秩的经验分配也可能错配全局预算。
row.synthesis_zh: GAWW使用on-policy蒸馏梯度构造面向生成行为的权重白化；再用进化搜索，在全局压缩预算下分配各层秩。
row.viewpoint_zh: 核对相同总字节和离线预算下，生成感知白化与全局秩搜索的独立消融；再检查两级GEMM和中间激活是否抵消权重节省。
row.implication_zh: 核对相同总字节和离线预算下，生成感知白化与全局秩搜索的独立消融；再检查两级GEMM和中间激活是否抵消权重节省。
row.boundary_zh: 目前仅摘要已读，不采用摘要中的SoTA措辞作跨条件最优结论；蒸馏梯度与全局搜索的离线代价仍待核对。
row.title_en: GA-SVD aligns whitening and global rank allocation with generation
row.question_en: SVD optimized for reconstruction or multiple-choice tasks may not preserve generation, while heuristic layer ranks may misallocate a global budget.
row.context_en: SVD optimized for reconstruction or multiple-choice tasks may not preserve generation, while heuristic layer ranks may misallocate a global budget.
row.synthesis_en: GAWW constructs generation-aligned weight whitening from on-policy distillation gradients; evolutionary search then allocates layer ranks under a global compression budget.
row.viewpoint_en: Ablate generation-aware whitening and global rank search at matched total bytes and offline cost, then measure both GEMMs and intermediate activations.
row.implication_en: Ablate generation-aware whitening and global rank search at matched total bytes and offline cost, then measure both GEMMs and intermediate activations.
row.boundary_en: Abstract reviewed only. The abstract's SoTA wording is not a cross-condition ranking; offline distillation-gradient and global-search costs still need checking.

row.selection_reason_zh: 补齐低秩技术在 KV 对象上的应用，与权重 GA-SVD 形成对象维度的对照；组合数字保留原有限定。
row.selection_reason_en: Extends low-rank coverage from GA-SVD weights to KV caches while retaining the limits of combined-scheme measurements.
row.title_zh: BELT：围绕注意力行为分配低秩 KV 的秩预算
row.question_zh: 直接重建 K 矩阵未必能保住注意力行为，各层低秩预算也不应只按统一比例分配。
row.context_zh: 直接重建 K 矩阵未必能保住注意力行为，各层低秩预算也不应只按统一比例分配。
row.synthesis_zh: 针对注意力分布构建二次代理并求闭式低秩解；训练时用可微软选择分配全局秩，部署时硬选择满足组件预算。
row.viewpoint_zh: 作为低秩与量化组合的观察项；最有价值的下一步是拆开低秩、量化和执行核的增益，比较同质量或同缓存预算。
row.implication_zh: 作为低秩与量化组合的观察项；最有价值的下一步是拆开低秩、量化和执行核的增益，比较同质量或同缓存预算。
row.boundary_zh: 仅摘要；各最大值未确认为同一模型/配置。17.8 倍与速度结果属于组合方案，不能全归因于低秩，也不等于整机显存减少。硬件、rank、位宽和基线仍需表格核验。
row.title_en: BELT: allocating low-rank KV budgets around attention behavior
row.question_en: Reconstructing raw keys may not preserve attention behavior, and rank budgets need not be uniform across layers.
row.context_en: Reconstructing raw keys may not preserve attention behavior, and rank budgets need not be uniform across layers.
row.synthesis_en: Forms a quadratic surrogate for attention distributions with a closed-form low-rank solution; differentiable soft rank selection during training becomes hard budgeted selection at deployment.
row.viewpoint_en: Track the low-rank/quantization combination; separate gains from factorization, quantization and kernels at equal quality or cache budgets.
row.implication_en: Track the low-rank/quantization combination; separate gains from factorization, quantization and kernels at equal quality or cache budgets.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only; maxima are not established as one model/configuration. The 17.8× and speed results include quantization and cannot be attributed solely to low rank or total-device memory. Hardware, ranks, bit widths and baselines need table-level checks.

row.selection_reason_zh: 保留与免旋转路线的对照，避免只报道一个方向而把研究取舍误写成确定答案。
row.selection_reason_en: Preserves a counterpoint to rotation-free methods, avoiding a one-sided account of an open design tradeoff.
row.title_zh: SpectrumQuant：以闭式谱对齐替代学习旋转的搜索
row.question_zh: 固定 Hadamard 变换与学习旋转之间存在质量和校准成本的取舍。
row.context_zh: 固定 Hadamard 变换与学习旋转之间存在质量和校准成本的取舍。
row.synthesis_zh: 从校准激活估计协方差，闭式构造由对齐与混合组成的正交变换；将 Hadamard 作为特例，并讨论一类蝶形矩阵。
row.viewpoint_zh: 与 CurveTQ 形成有价值的对照：一条降低旋转求解成本，一条探索免旋转。应分别比较校准成本、存储开销与推理核。
row.implication_zh: 与 CurveTQ 形成有价值的对照：一条降低旋转求解成本，一条探索免旋转。应分别比较校准成本、存储开销与推理核。
row.boundary_zh: 摘要没有列出位宽、精确分数和设备；这里的内存/时间属于旋转求解与校准，不是推理阶段显存或服务时延。本月首发，当前观察 v2。
row.title_en: SpectrumQuant: closed-form spectral alignment instead of learned-rotation search
row.question_en: Fixed Hadamard transforms and learned rotations trade off quality and calibration cost.
row.context_en: Fixed Hadamard transforms and learned rotations trade off quality and calibration cost.
row.synthesis_en: Estimates activation covariance and constructs a closed-form orthogonal transform composed of alignment and mixing, recovering Hadamard as a special case and covering a class of butterfly matrices.
row.viewpoint_en: A useful contrast to CurveTQ: one lowers rotation-fitting cost, the other investigates avoiding rotation. Compare calibration, storage and inference-kernel costs separately.
row.implication_en: A useful contrast to CurveTQ: one lowers rotation-fitting cost, the other investigates avoiding rotation. Compare calibration, storage and inference-kernel costs separately.
row.boundary_en: The abstract omits bit widths, exact scores and devices. Memory/time concern rotation fitting and calibration, not inference memory or serving latency. First submitted this month; the observed version is v2.

row.selection_reason_zh: 补齐此前完全缺失的 KV 量化，并把格式误差与具体注意力结构、执行实现联系起来。
row.selection_reason_en: Fills the missing KV-quantization coverage and connects representation error to attention structure and implementation.
row.title_zh: RoLaQ：联合控制 MLA 潜变量的匹配误差与读出误差
row.question_zh: MLA 的共享潜变量同时影响注意力匹配和值读出；降到两比特后，仅看逐元素重建误差不足以描述影响。
row.context_zh: MLA 的共享潜变量同时影响注意力匹配和值读出；降到两比特后，仅看逐元素重建误差不足以描述影响。
row.synthesis_zh: 在冻结 K/V 投影定义的子空间中校准共享旋转，同时耦合量化范围阈值与重建增益；用预测匹配和注意力输出监督，保持模型权重冻结。
row.viewpoint_zh: 值得作为低比特 KV 的独立主线：先按注意力架构分组，再比较相同缓存预算下的质量和真实服务执行。
row.implication_zh: 值得作为低比特 KV 的独立主线：先按注意力架构分组，再比较相同缓存预算下的质量和真实服务执行。
row.boundary_zh: 仅摘要核对，硬件、并发和保护 token 配置尚需原文确认。容量倍数不是整机峰值内存下降比例，decode 吞吐不是单请求 TPOT；MLA 结论不能直接推广到普通 MHA/GQA。
row.title_en: RoLaQ: jointly calibrating matching and readout errors in MLA latents
row.question_en: An MLA latent affects both attention matching and value readout; at two bits, elementwise reconstruction error alone is insufficient.
row.context_en: An MLA latent affects both attention matching and value readout; at two bits, elementwise reconstruction error alone is insufficient.
row.synthesis_en: Calibrates a shared rotation within subspaces defined by frozen K/V projections, coupling range thresholds and reconstruction gains with prediction-matching and attention-output supervision. Model weights remain frozen.
row.viewpoint_en: Treat as an independent low-bit KV route: group by attention architecture, then compare quality and serving execution at equal cache budgets.
row.implication_en: Treat as an independent low-bit KV route: group by attention architecture, then compare quality and serving execution at equal cache budgets.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only; hardware, concurrency and token-protection settings need confirmation. Capacity is not total peak-memory reduction, and decode throughput is not single-request TPOT. MLA findings do not automatically transfer to MHA/GQA.

row.selection_reason_zh: 保留一条与低比特 KV 不同的选择/驱逐路线，并用内核到端到端的收益落差说明执行成本。
row.selection_reason_en: Adds eviction as an alternative to low-bit KV, using the kernel/end-to-end gap to highlight execution cost.
row.title_zh: DropKV：把缓存驱逐目标与可执行的评分核连起来
row.question_zh: 联合决定删除哪些 KV 项是组合优化问题；近似策略的质量与评分开销都可能抵消容量收益。
row.context_zh: 联合决定删除哪些 KV 项是组合优化问题；近似策略的质量与评分开销都可能抵消容量收益。
row.synthesis_zh: 将残差输出扰动解耦为逐 token 评分，在锥条件下提供常数近似保证，并用融合 Triton 核避免完整注意力矩阵。
row.viewpoint_zh: 以同缓存预算比较质量，再独立比较评分开销与完整 prefill，避免选择算法减少容量却增加总体时延。
row.implication_zh: 以同缓存预算比较质量，再独立比较评分开销与完整 prefill，避免选择算法减少容量却增加总体时延。
row.boundary_zh: 这是 KV 驱逐，不是数值量化或参数剪枝。近似保证有锥条件，19.8 倍不是模型端到端加速；prefill 计时不能直接写成服务 TTFT。当前仅核对摘要。
row.title_en: DropKV: connecting eviction objectives to practical scoring kernels
row.question_en: Joint KV eviction is combinatorial; both approximation quality and scoring overhead can offset capacity benefits.
row.context_en: Joint KV eviction is combinatorial; both approximation quality and scoring overhead can offset capacity benefits.
row.synthesis_en: Decouples residual-output perturbation into per-token scores, with a constant-factor guarantee under a cone condition and fused Triton kernels avoiding the full attention matrix.
row.viewpoint_en: Compare quality at equal cache budgets, then score-computation cost and complete prefill separately, avoiding capacity savings that increase total latency.
row.implication_en: Compare quality at equal cache budgets, then score-computation cost and complete prefill separately, avoiding capacity savings that increase total latency.
row.boundary_en: This is KV eviction, not numerical quantization or parameter pruning. The approximation has a cone condition; 19.8× is not end-to-end model speedup, and prefill timing is not automatically serving TTFT. Abstract checked only.

row.selection_reason_zh: 补充 LLM 之外的具体领域证据，并展示组件压缩与整模型收益的区别。
row.selection_reason_en: Adds concrete non-LLM domain evidence and distinguishes component compression from whole-model benefit.
row.title_zh: 语音特征蒸馏：用两层提取器替换多个模型的 CNN 前端
row.question_zh: 自监督语音模型的 CNN 局部特征提取层计算较重，多模型间又有相似结构，存在共享的小型替代器机会。
row.context_zh: 自监督语音模型的 CNN 局部特征提取层计算较重，多模型间又有相似结构，存在共享的小型替代器机会。
row.synthesis_zh: 从 HuBERT、data2vec、WavLM 的一个或多个教师蒸馏两层特征提取器，并考察迁移到未见过的 wav2vec 2.0。
row.viewpoint_zh: 保留领域模型的独立蒸馏路线，提示压缩可以替换昂贵组件而不必缩小整个网络；后续核对流式场景与任务质量。
row.implication_zh: 保留领域模型的独立蒸馏路线，提示压缩可以替换昂贵组件而不必缩小整个网络；后续核对流式场景与任务质量。
row.boundary_zh: 3% 是前端 CNN 计算量口径，不是整模型只剩 3%；具体设备、任务分数和逐配置时间未在摘要列全，不称无损或普适加速。
row.title_en: Speech-feature distillation: a two-layer substitute for CNN front ends
row.question_en: CNN local-feature extractors in self-supervised speech models are expensive and structurally similar, suggesting a shared compact replacement.
row.context_en: CNN local-feature extractors in self-supervised speech models are expensive and structurally similar, suggesting a shared compact replacement.
row.synthesis_en: Distills a two-layer feature extractor from one or more HuBERT, data2vec and WavLM teachers, including transfer to unseen wav2vec 2.0.
row.viewpoint_en: Retains standalone distillation for domain models: replace an expensive component without necessarily shrinking the whole network; check streaming settings and task quality.
row.implication_en: Retains standalone distillation for domain models: replace an expensive component without necessarily shrinking the whole network; check streaming settings and task quality.
row.boundary_en: The 3% denominator is front-end CNN computation, not the entire model. Devices, exact task scores and per-configuration timings are incomplete in the abstract; this is not lossless or universal acceleration.

row.selection_reason_zh: 将专家宽度分配与通道选择拆开，并提供同剪枝率的质量及服务时延证据；补充MoE内部结构压缩这一主线。
row.selection_reason_en: Separates expert-width allocation from channel selection and reports quality and serving latency at the same pruning ratio, covering structured compression within MoE experts.
row.title_zh: UC-RAMP：分开分配专家宽度与选择通道，时延下降但质量仍有代价
row.question_zh: 专家内部剪枝既要决定各专家保留多宽，也要决定留下哪些相互作用的通道；全局重要性排名把这两个问题混在一起。
row.context_zh: 专家内部剪枝既要决定各专家保留多宽，也要决定留下哪些相互作用的通道；全局重要性排名把这两个问题混在一起。
row.synthesis_zh: CAPE根据跨域校准证据分配各专家保留宽度；RAMP固定宽度，用考虑通道交互的一进一出交换改善通道组成。不修改路由器，也不做梯度更新。
row.viewpoint_zh: 重点比较宽度分配与通道组成各自带来的质量恢复；在讨论迁移前，先核查自定义核对非均匀专家宽度的执行成本。
row.implication_zh: 重点比较宽度分配与通道组成各自带来的质量恢复；在讨论迁移前，先核查自定义核对非均匀专家宽度的执行成本。
row.boundary_zh: 已核对§4.4、Table 3和附录A。25%不是整模型内存节省率；小样本中位数计时不是P95服务SLO。该质量结果尚未满足小于1%的损失目标，且没有昇腾测试。
row.title_en: UC-RAMP: separate expert widths from channel selection; latency gains still cost quality
row.question_en: Expert-internal pruning must choose both retained expert widths and interacting channel memberships; a global importance ranking combines these decisions.
row.context_en: Expert-internal pruning must choose both retained expert widths and interacting channel memberships; a global importance ranking combines these decisions.
row.synthesis_en: CAPE allocates retained expert widths using cross-domain calibration. RAMP refines channel membership by interaction-aware one-out, one-in exchanges at fixed widths, without changing the router or using gradient updates.
row.viewpoint_en: Separate the quality contributions of width allocation and channel selection, then inspect the cost of nonuniform expert kernels before considering migration.
row.implication_en: Separate the quality contributions of width allocation and channel selection, then inspect the cost of nonuniform expert kernels before considering migration.
row.boundary_en: Sections 4.4, Table 3 and Appendix A were checked. The pruning ratio is not a whole-model memory reduction. Median timing from a small experiment is not a P95 serving SLO. The reported quality loss exceeds the project's 1% target; no Ascend result is established.

row.selection_reason_zh: 填补独立蒸馏缺口，研究问题清楚：在不要求相同分词器的情况下扩大小模型可用教师范围。
row.selection_reason_en: Fills the standalone-distillation gap with a clear question: expanding the teacher pool for small students without requiring identical tokenizers.
row.title_zh: CSD：对齐不同分词器，让小模型利用跨模型家族的教师
row.question_zh: 师生词表及切分不同，下一 token 分布不能直接比较；共享词表或人工选择损失会限制知识迁移。
row.context_zh: 师生词表及切分不同，下一 token 分布不能直接比较；共享词表或人工选择损失会限制知识迁移。
row.synthesis_zh: 在对齐文本块上构建共同支持集：一对一时显式匹配 token，其余用自回归链式概率建立虚拟支持，并用残余事件保留支持集外的概率质量。
row.viewpoint_zh: 把蒸馏专题从“剪枝后的恢复”拓展到独立的师生知识迁移；优先核对共同支持构造的额外训练成本与同分词器基线。
row.implication_zh: 把蒸馏专题从“剪枝后的恢复”拓展到独立的师生知识迁移；优先核对共同支持构造的额外训练成本与同分词器基线。
row.boundary_zh: 当前只核对摘要；具体任务、教师规模和训练成本未充分展开，未报告服务时延或显存收益。不能称无损蒸馏，也不能把跨设置最高分拼成统一优胜结论。
row.title_en: CSD: common support for distillation across tokenizer families
row.question_en: Different teacher/student vocabularies and segmentations prevent direct next-token matching; shared-vocabulary restrictions and hand-chosen losses constrain transfer.
row.context_en: Different teacher/student vocabularies and segmentations prevent direct next-token matching; shared-vocabulary restrictions and hand-chosen losses constrain transfer.
row.synthesis_en: Builds common support over aligned chunks: explicit token pairs for one-to-one alignments, autoregressive-chain-rule virtual support otherwise, plus a residual event to preserve normalization.
row.viewpoint_en: Extends distillation beyond post-pruning recovery to standalone teacher-student transfer. Check the training cost of support construction and same-tokenizer baselines.
row.implication_en: Extends distillation beyond post-pruning recovery to standalone teacher-student transfer. Check the training cost of support construction and same-tokenizer baselines.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only. Tasks, teacher sizes and training costs need further detail; serving latency and memory benefits are not reported. This is not lossless distillation, and maxima across settings are not one universal comparison.

row.selection_reason_zh: 把稀疏索引开销纳入与位宽的共同预算，回答继续降位宽还是叠加2:4稀疏的取舍；价值在可比较条件，而非单一压缩率。
row.selection_reason_en: Counts sparse indices in the joint bit budget to compare lower precision with added 2:4 sparsity. The contribution is a comparable tradeoff, not an isolated compression ratio.
row.title_zh: 2:4与量化如何取舍：先算索引，再比较下一步压缩
row.question_zh: 在相同成本下，继续降低稠密精度还是叠加2:4稀疏，不能只按标称保留比例判断。
row.context_zh: 在相同成本下，继续降低稠密精度还是叠加2:4稀疏，不能只按标称保留比例判断。
row.synthesis_zh: 在包含位置索引、尺度及在线预处理的同成本条件下，比较叠加2:4稀疏和继续降低稠密精度，而非只比较标称保留比例。
row.viewpoint_zh: 稀疏与量化组合的对照应对齐完整存储成本、质量和执行路径；到最低可执行精度后，再评估叠加稀疏及恢复训练是否划算。
row.implication_zh: 稀疏与量化组合的对照应对齐完整存储成本、质量和执行路径；到最低可执行精度后，再评估叠加稀疏及恢复训练是否划算。
row.boundary_zh: 已核对位数记账、量化下限与硬件条件章节。结论受GPU代际、格式、推理栈和恢复训练预算约束；不能推广成所有2:4方案无价值，也不是昇腾适配证据。
row.title_en: Choosing 2:4 versus quantization requires counting indices and the next precision step
row.question_en: The choice between lower dense precision and added 2:4 sparsity at equal cost cannot be settled by nominal retention ratios.
row.context_en: The choice between lower dense precision and added 2:4 sparsity at equal cost cannot be settled by nominal retention ratios.
row.synthesis_en: Compare adding 2:4 sparsity with reducing dense precision at matched cost, including indices, scales and online preprocessing, rather than nominal retained-value counts.
row.viewpoint_en: Align complete storage, quality and execution costs; evaluate sparsity and recovery training only against the next executable dense-precision option.
row.implication_en: Align complete storage, quality and execution costs; evaluate sparsity and recovery training only against the next executable dense-precision option.
row.boundary_en: Bit accounting, quantization-floor and hardware sections were checked. Results depend on GPU generation, format, serving stack and recovery budget; they neither dismiss every 2:4 method nor establish Ascend support.

row.selection_reason_zh: 引入联合率失真编码这一新机制，同时明确其存储目标，防止巨大压缩倍数掩盖运行路径差异。
row.selection_reason_en: Adds joint rate-distortion coding while making its storage objective explicit, so large ratios do not hide execution-path differences.
row.title_zh: DCKV：把提示 KV 缓存当作可学习的率失真编码对象
row.question_zh: 混合模型虽只有少量完整注意力层，提示 KV 仍随上下文增长，复用时需要存储或传输。
row.context_zh: 混合模型虽只有少量完整注意力层，提示 KV 仍随上下文增长，复用时需要存储或传输。
row.synthesis_zh: 联合训练变换、量化器和熵模型，以提示 token 与已解码邻位为条件，在冻结语言模型上同时优化编码长度与模型输出变化。
row.viewpoint_zh: 将其作为提示缓存存储/搬运方向观察，与在线低比特 Attention 分开比较；先核查复用次数能否摊薄编解码成本。
row.implication_zh: 将其作为提示缓存存储/搬运方向观察，与在线低比特 Attention 分开比较；先核查复用次数能否摊薄编解码成本。
row.boundary_zh: 仅摘要。码流大小不等于生成时活跃 KV 或总峰值显存；编码/解码开销、随机访问和注意力执行方式未在摘要中完整报告，不把字节数倍数写成服务加速。
row.title_en: DCKV: learned rate-distortion coding for prompt KV storage
row.question_en: Even hybrid models with few full-attention layers retain prompt KV state that grows with context and must be stored or transferred for reuse.
row.context_en: Even hybrid models with few full-attention layers retain prompt KV state that grows with context and must be stored or transferred for reuse.
row.synthesis_en: Jointly trains transforms, quantizers and entropy models conditioned on prompt tokens and decoded neighbors, optimizing code length and output changes against a frozen language model.
row.viewpoint_en: Track it as prompt-cache storage/transfer research, separately from online low-bit attention; check whether reuse amortizes codec costs.
row.implication_en: Track it as prompt-cache storage/transfer research, separately from online low-bit attention; check whether reuse amortizes codec costs.
row.boundary_en: Abstract only. Bitstream size is not live generation KV or total peak memory. Encoding/decoding cost, random access and attention execution are not fully reported; byte reduction is not serving speedup.

TopK-Guided has no abstract-level hardware-throughput result. SpAx averages 3.86× for tested CPU-offloaded 16-bit weights with at most a 10% WikiText-2 perplexity increase; this does not generalize to resident weights or all tasks.
row.boundary_zh: TopK-Guided摘要没有硬件吞吐；SpAx平均3.86倍仅针对所测CPU卸载16-bit权重，且WikiText-2 PPL增幅上限10%。不能外推到显存常驻或所有业务。
row.context_en: The activations to retain vary by token. Assess sparsity strategies by considering quality loss, compute and transfer budgets, and irregular-access overhead together.
row.context_zh: 需要保留的激活会随 token 变化。评估稀疏策略时，需要同时比较质量损失、计算与搬运预算，以及不规则访问的开销。
row.implication_en: distinguish resident from offloaded weights. For TopK-like adaptive budgets with resident weights, account for selection/indexing and whether actual operators skip computation. For SpAx-like three-level offload reads, track bytes per token, approximate-weight storage and fragmented access. Compare both with simple fixed budgets at a fixed task-quality threshold. If execution remains dense, or random access offsets saved bytes, sparsity alone cannot justify deployment. CPU-offload gains do not transfer to Ascend resident weights.
row.implication_zh: 先区分权重常驻与权重卸载。常驻场景评估TopK式动态预算时，核对选择／索引开销以及剩余计算能否由实际算子跳过；卸载场景评估SpAx式三档读取时，核对每token实际搬运字节、近似权重存储及访问碎片。两者都应固定任务质量门槛并与简单固定预算比较。若算子仍做完整稠密计算，或随机访问抵消字节节省，较高稀疏率不足以支持部署选择；CPU卸载实验的收益不能沿用于昇腾常驻权重。
row.question_en: How should activations be selected for omission, and how do compute savings differ from transfer savings?
row.question_zh: 如何选择可以省略的激活，并区分计算节省与数据传输节省？
row.synthesis_en: TopK-Guided adapts sparsity across tokens and layers. SpAx chooses original, compressed or skipped weight reads. Both go beyond fixed thresholds, but the former emphasizes quality at comparable compute budgets, while the latter targets offloaded-weight transfers.
row.synthesis_zh: TopK-Guided在token和层之间调整稀疏预算；SpAx把权重读取分为原精度、压缩近似和跳过三档。二者共同超越固定阈值，但前者主要给出同预算质量证据，后者针对权重卸载搬运。
row.title_en: Activation sparsity in practice: adaptive budgets control quality, while weight approximation reduces offload transfers
row.title_zh: 激活稀疏的实际收益：自适应预算控制质量，权重近似减少卸载传输
row.viewpoint_en: Select sparsity after identifying the bottleneck. Compute-bound inference and CPU/flash offloading require different evaluation; fewer FLOPs or bytes do not automatically mean faster end-to-end execution.
row.viewpoint_zh: 先识别瓶颈，再选择稀疏策略。片上计算受限与CPU/闪存卸载受限的评价对象不同，降低FLOPs或搬运字节不自动等于端到端提速。

row.boundary_en: Page-EntroKV’s inflation factor of 1 is a replay result, not measured throughput. The other abstracts lack one comparable speedup figure. KL scoring has computation cost.
row.boundary_zh: Page-EntroKV的预算膨胀系数1来自回放，不是吞吐实测；另外两篇摘要没有统一加速倍数。KL评分也增加计算，不能称零开销。
row.context_en: KV eviction raises three questions: which entries matter, when to remove them, and how to release physical space under GQA and paged caching.
row.context_zh: KV 驱逐需要回答三个问题：哪些缓存更重要、何时做出删除决定，以及如何在 GQA 和分页缓存中真正释放空间。
row.implication_en: first compare actually released pages and task quality at the same retention budget, then evaluate complex scoring. Page-EntroKV addresses GQA group/page enforcement; DeferKV uses the first decode signal for one-shot selection, with waiting/compaction costs; Behavior-Preserving uses KL-sensitive removal, with scoring costs. Against a simple baseline at the same page granularity, record page occupancy, compaction/eviction time, TTFT and decode. If logical deletion frees no pages, fix cache management first. If scoring improves quality at a latency cost, decide against the business quality threshold. The three mechanisms are not a validated combined algorithm.
row.implication_zh: 先比较同保留预算下“实际释放页数＋目标任务质量”，再评估复杂评分。Page-EntroKV对应GQA组／页预算落实；DeferKV对应利用首步decode信号改善一次性决策，需计首步等待与整理成本；Behavior-Preserving对应按KL影响选删项，需计评分计算。与相同页粒度的简单基线比较时，记录物理页占用、整理／驱逐耗时、TTFT和decode。若只删逻辑token而未回收页，应先解决缓存管理；若评分改善质量但增加时延，应按业务质量门槛决定是否采用。不要把三篇机制拼成已验证的组合方案。
row.question_en: How can actual cache use meet the retention budget while preserving task quality?
row.question_zh: 如何在保持任务质量的同时，让实际缓存占用符合保留预算？
row.synthesis_en: Behavior-Preserving estimates deletion cost through output-distribution KL; DeferKV waits for the first real decoding signal; Page-EntroKV enforces budgets at group/page granularity. They answer what, when and how, without a demonstrated combined experiment.
row.synthesis_zh: Behavior-Preserving按输出分布KL变化估计删项代价；DeferKV等首步真实decode信号后再驱逐；Page-EntroKV在组与页粒度落实预算。三者分别回答“删什么、何时删、如何落地”，尚无三者组合实验。
row.title_en: Quality and memory costs of KV eviction: page budgets, deferred decisions and output-distribution scoring
row.title_zh: KV 淘汰的质量与内存开销：页级预算、延迟决策与输出分布评分
row.viewpoint_en: Retained-token ratios alone omit physical occupancy and decision loss. Track quality, actual page occupancy and scoring/eviction overhead together.
row.viewpoint_zh: 只比较保留token比例容易遗漏真实占用和决策损失。研究应同时保存质量、物理页占用与评分/驱逐开销；这比单一压缩比更有解释力。

row.boundary_en: AttSVD reports near-full-cache quality at about half KV memory on tested benchmarks, without abstract-level hardware speedup. SAGA’s over-2× decoding result is on models up to 1.5B and entails architecture changes or fine-tuning.
row.boundary_zh: AttSVD约半量KV而维持相近质量是作者所测基准结果，摘要没有硬件加速；SAGA超过2倍来自最高1.5B模型长上下文，且需要结构改造或微调。
row.context_en: Low-rank caches and K/V-head sharing are distinct routes: one changes prompt-specific representation; the other changes model architecture.
row.context_zh: 低秩缓存与K/V头共享是不同技术路线：一个改变当前提示的表示，另一个改变模型结构。
row.implication_en: Choose a method based on whether the application permits model changes and retraining. For a preserved model, test whether long generation amortizes AttSVD decomposition, compressed-cache use and reconstruction; include factors, workspace and prefill. If architecture changes are allowed, assess SAGA's asymmetric K/V layout, sparse selection, training/fine-tuning and Attention-operator integration. Compare each with its own matched baseline for quality, total cache and end-to-end time, not one acceleration ranking. Short outputs may not amortize decomposition; excessive architecture-maintenance cost favors retaining existing KV quantization/budget paths.
row.implication_zh: 先判断业务是否允许修改模型结构并重新训练，再选择技术方案。保持既有模型时，评估AttSVD的分解、压缩缓存与重构能否在长生成中摊薄成本，计入因子、工作区和prefill；允许结构改造时，评估SAGA的非对称K/V头布局、稀疏选择、训练／微调成本及Attention算子适配。两者分别与自身同条件基线比较质量、总缓存和端到端时延，不能共用一个加速排行。短输出难以摊薄分解成本，或结构修改超出维护预算时，应先保留现有KV量化／缓存预算方案。
row.question_en: Beyond reducing bit width or token count, what benefits and costs arise from changing representation dimensions and head structure?
row.question_zh: 除了降低位宽或减少 token，改变表示维度与头结构能带来哪些收益和代价？
row.synthesis_en: AttSVD uses prompt-adaptive attention-guided truncated SVD. SAGA decouples K/V-head counts and adds Atop-N sparse selection. They target cache rank and key-side computation, respectively, rather than comparable performance points.
row.synthesis_zh: AttSVD按提示注意力几何做截断SVD；SAGA把K/V头数解耦并配合Atop-N稀疏选择。它们展示了缓存维度与K侧计算两种压缩对象，不能放进同一性能排行。
row.title_en: Compressing KV representations: prompt-adaptive low-rank factorization and asymmetric K/V heads
row.title_zh: KV 表示压缩：提示自适应低秩分解与非对称 K/V 头结构
row.viewpoint_en: Track representation compression alongside token eviction, while accounting separately for training/fine-tuning in architectural changes. Distinguish model-preserving methods and prefill/decode costs.
row.viewpoint_zh: 表示压缩值得与token驱逐并行跟踪；架构改造则单列训练/微调成本。选路时先区分能否保持原模型，以及压缩发生在prefill还是持续decode。

row.boundary_en: The 1.87× peak throughput is from Qwen3-4B on one RTX6000 Ada in SGLang under specified long-generation conditions. TTFT rises 10%–14% for 8K–32K prompts; it is not a cost-free same-batch speedup.
row.boundary_zh: 1.87倍峰值吞吐来自Qwen3-4B、单RTX6000 Ada、SGLang和指定长生成设置；8K–32K提示TTFT增加10%–14%。不是同batch无代价加速。
row.context_en: KV is not a static weight matrix: its quantization space must reflect query sensitivity, head scales and channel covariance.
row.context_zh: KV不是静态权重；量化空间需要反映查询敏感性、头间尺度和通道相关性。
row.implication_en: evaluate TaSQ's query-sensitive quantization space, not the 1-bit label alone. Against an executable scalar-KV baseline, fix model, context and quality threshold; include codebooks, scales and high-precision residuals in actual KV bytes, and measure feasible batch, TTFT and per-token decode. Include lookup, layout transforms and query-statistics costs. For capacity-bound workloads that tolerate extra prefill time, test whether batch capacity improves. A strict first-token SLA or higher same-batch lookup cost can rule it out despite peak throughput. The GPU 1.87× is not an Ascend forecast.
row.implication_zh: TaSQ值得比较的是查询敏感的量化空间，不是“1-bit”标签本身。先以当前可执行的KV标量量化为基线，在相同模型、上下文与质量门槛下，统计码本／scale／保留高精度部分后的实际KV字节、可服务batch、TTFT与每token解码时延；码本查询、布局变换和查询统计须计入。若场景受KV容量限制且能容忍prefill增加，可评估它是否扩大可服务batch；若首词SLA严格或同batch时码本开销更高，则不应仅据峰值吞吐选择该路线。GPU的1.87倍不是昇腾预期值。
row.question_en: How can very-low-bit KV representations control attention error and preserve long-generation quality?
row.question_zh: 如何在极低比特 KV 表示下，控制注意力误差并保持长序列生成质量？
row.synthesis_en: TaSQ combines query-guided weighting, cross-head normalization and covariance-aware grouping, folding RoPE-compatible transforms into projections and codebooks. One reviewed current-month paper supports this route; it does not establish field-wide convergence.
row.synthesis_zh: TaSQ组合查询引导加权、跨头归一化和协方差分组，并把兼容RoPE的变换并入投影与码本。当前只有这一篇已审阅当月直接证据，不据此声称全领域已经收敛。
row.title_en: Error control for 1-bit KV: query weighting, cross-head normalization and covariance-based grouping
row.title_zh: 1-bit KV 的误差控制：查询加权、跨头归一化与协方差分组
row.viewpoint_en: The key idea is to prioritize quantization errors that affect attention output, rather than minimizing elementwise reconstruction error alone. Evaluate serviceable batch size, peak throughput and first-token latency separately.
row.viewpoint_zh: 这条路线关注的重点是：优先控制会影响注意力输出的量化误差，而不是只追求每个元素的重构误差最小。评估效果时，应分别比较可服务批量、峰值吞吐和首 token 时延。

row.boundary_en: OSFP4 retains 94%–97% of vendor NVFP4 throughput; this is not a speedup. AlignQuant reports an upper bound of 2.50× in tested configurations. The two numbers are not directly comparable.
row.boundary_zh: OSFP4的94%–97%是相对厂商NVFP4基线的吞吐保留，不是加速；AlignQuant的2.50倍是所测配置上限，两者不能直接比较。
row.context_en: These works couple error optimization with execution layout: one targets NVFP4, the other GPU-compatible two-dimensional tiles.
row.context_zh: 这组工作把误差优化与执行布局一起考虑：一项围绕NVFP4格式，另一项围绕GPU二维tile。
row.implication_en: map grouping, scale layout and packed shapes to available matrix-product operators before choosing the algorithm. OSFP4 motivates joint smoothing/block-scale error control, but its NVFP4 throughput is GPU-path-specific. AlignQuant motivates aligning precision assignment with execution tiles, not copying its tile configuration. Compare with a supported regular-quantization baseline, separating quality, rearrangement, dequantization and matrix-product time, then end-to-end prefill/decode. If a smaller file runs slower, fix layout/kernel integration before reducing bits further.
row.implication_zh: 先把目标量化格式的分组、scale布局和打包形状映射到可用矩阵乘算子，再选算法。OSFP4可提供联合平滑／块尺度的误差控制思路，但NVFP4吞吐结论依赖原GPU路径；AlignQuant可提供精度分配与执行tile对齐的思路，不能照搬其tile配置。与已支持的规则量化基线比较时，分别记录质量、重排、反量化及矩阵乘耗时，并看prefill／decode端到端结果；离线文件更小而执行更慢时，优先修布局与核衔接，不急于继续降位宽。
row.question_en: After model storage is reduced, which execution costs can still limit generation speed?
row.question_zh: 模型存储量减少后，哪些执行开销仍可能限制生成速度？
row.synthesis_en: OSFP4 jointly optimizes smoothing and block scales while retaining native NVFP4 throughput. AlignQuant unifies precision, packing and phase-specific kernels around tiles. Their operating points differ: native-format efficiency versus regular mixed-precision execution.
row.synthesis_zh: OSFP4联合优化平滑和块尺度，在原生NVFP4路径上保留吞吐；AlignQuant以tile统一精度分配、打包存储和阶段专用核。前者关注特定格式的精度/效率平衡，后者关注混合精度的规则执行。
row.title_en: Quantization quality and execution efficiency: smoothing and block scales control error, while tile alignment reduces execution costs
row.title_zh: 量化精度与执行效率：平滑和块尺度控制误差，计算块对齐减少执行开销
row.viewpoint_en: The transferable idea is to align quantization granularity and storage layout with execution units; a specific GPU format still requires separate adaptation. Compare both prefill and decode when choosing a deployment method.
row.viewpoint_zh: 对昇腾值得借鉴的是量化粒度、存储布局与计算单元的匹配方式，具体 GPU 格式仍需另行适配。选择部署方案时，应同时比较 prefill 和 decode 的效果。

row.boundary_en: Models, baselines and quality metrics differ. The 2-bit, 1.61-bit and perplexity results cannot form one ranking. No Ascend end-to-end result is established.
row.boundary_zh: 三篇工作的模型、基线和质量指标不一致；2-bit、1.61-bit及PPL改善不能拼成统一排行榜。没有昇腾端到端结果。
row.context_en: These works address extreme quantization under different constraints: multi-precision deployment, component bit budgets and post-quantization recovery.
row.context_zh: 这组工作围绕极低比特误差展开，但约束不同：多精度部署、低秩分量的位宽预算、量化后的误差恢复。
row.implication_en: compare the three routes separately at a fixed target quality and total storage budget. When several deployment precisions must share one model, test whether StagQ prefix reads reduce duplicate model storage. For SVD component bit allocation, include zero-bit removals, indices and scales. For Align, Then Correct, include adapter weights, extra matrix products and intermediate tensors. First confirm that target operators consume the stream/branches, then measure total bytes and prefill/decode time. Reject a lower-bit choice if quality-restoring compensation offsets the saving. Combined gains remain unestablished.
row.implication_zh: 在同一目标质量和总存储预算下分开比较三条路线。多部署精度需要共享一份模型时，评估StagQ前缀读取是否减少重复模型存储；选择SVD分量位宽时，把零比特删项、索引和尺度计入预算；采用Align, Then Correct时，把低秩分支的权重、额外矩阵乘与中间张量计入成本。先确认目标算子能消费码流／分支，再测总字节、prefill和decode时延。若恢复质量依赖的补偿抵消节省，则不应仅因主权重位宽更低而选它。三条路线尚无组合收益证据。
row.question_en: With 1–2-bit weights, how should model quality be balanced against encoding and compensation overhead?
row.question_zh: 在 1–2 bit 权重表示下，如何权衡模型质量与编码、补偿带来的额外开销？
row.synthesis_en: StagQ uses a prefix stream for multiple precisions; Differentiable Bit-Widths jointly chooses retained SVD components and precision; Align, Then Correct repairs an already quantized model with low-rank adapters. These are complementary mechanisms, without evidence of combined gains.
row.synthesis_zh: StagQ把多部署精度放进一条前缀码流；可微位宽方法把SVD分量的保留与量化联合优化；Align, Then Correct则用低秩适配器恢复已量化模型。它们是互补机制，现有证据没有证明组合后收益。
row.title_en: Quality and total cost of 1–2-bit weights: progressive encoding, SVD bit allocation and low-rank compensation
row.title_zh: 1–2 bit 权重的质量与总成本：渐进编码、SVD 位宽分配与低秩补偿
row.viewpoint_en: At the same total storage budget, compare how capacity is split between quantized encoding and error compensation, and which allocation preserves task quality. Include metadata, outlier side streams, adapters and calibration costs.
row.viewpoint_zh: 应比较的是：在相同总存储预算下，多少容量用于量化编码，多少用于误差补偿，哪种分配能保住业务质量。评估时还需计入元数据、旁路异常值、适配器和校准成本。
